name: WDGG burnFrom without authorization burns the PancakeSwap pair reserve
summary: The WDGG implementation's burnFrom(from,value) debits any holder's balance with no allowance or caller check (and setWdgAddress lets anyone mark themselves fee-exempt). The attacker exempted its contract, bought 45.62 WDGG, burned 399,902.21 WDGG straight out of the WDGG/USDT pair, called sync() and sold the 45.62 WDGG for 40,008.28 USDT. Two later actors repeated the pair burn against newly added liquidity.
notes: ProxyAdmin 0x1c429de906de3f1b9204eb9aacaf4b415b408fae upgradeAndCall (0x9623609d, empty data) by deployer 0xd72063c8 switched the WDGG proxy from 0xef121a21c01e90165800d31e360003c185aa650d to WDGG 0x512de7b4, the fifth and last implementation before the exploit.

Per-campaign USDT depletion of the WDGG/USDT pair 0xc0b42a79928c9ab3f5fe424936f4241fdea53c30 net of the attacker's own USDT paid into it in the same transaction (4.575, 0.000000006861796509 and 0.01508886692637168 USDT). BSC-USD valued at par. The second and third campaigns are later actors against the same implementation (source-7).
